A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we report an Iranian infant with PS and 8.5 Kb deletion in mtDNA.
mtDNA deletion can be detected in peripheral blood in patients with Pearson marrow syndrome and the diagnosis can be made without bone marrow biopsy.
mtDNA deletion is a common cause of Pearson marrow syndrome in Iranian infants and it should be considered in differential diagnosis of patients with cytopenia, acidosis and refractory anemia.
